description: This is a PHP controller file for the WorkShift module within the OrangeHRM admin plugin. It extends an abstract Vue controller and prepares a Vue component for rendering the work shift list in the UI.

classes.name: WorkShiftController
classes.description: Controller responsible for handling work shift views in the admin plugin, extending Vue-based controller functionality.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component 'work-shift-list' for rendering by setting it in the controller before the view is rendered.
